items.title: 66100_Bud Freeman oral history interview
items.q: it seems to me the pianist was Roy Bargy from time to time

ctx.x: I got an offer then to go with Paul Whiteman just for a short spell. Carl Kress, the guitar player who died a few years back. I joined a little band in the Whiteman band. We were doing the a program which was called the Woodbury Soap Hour, which was a big radio show, and as a matter of fact, Johnny Mercer was writing material, songs, and singing in a group on the show, and in the band were Jack Teagarden, Charlie Teagarden, his brother, a marvelous trumpet player, let's see, Frank Trumbauer, C-melody saxophone. I…

And so we had that little band and that was all we did, and then we made a few records with Whiteman. I was only with him maybe a month. And then I got the offer to go with Tommy Dorsey and went with Tommy.
